description: Let \(K\) be a class with amalgamation and let \(B,C_i,D_i\in K\). A finite family of amalgamation requests over the fixed member \(B\) has simultaneous answers in one member \(Q\). There is one embedding \(b:B\hookrightarrow Q\) and embeddings \(h_i:D_i\hookrightarrow Q\) such that \(b\circ f_i=h_i\circ g_i\) for every prescribed pair \(f_i:C_i\hookrightarrow B\), \(g_i:C_i\hookrightarrow D_i\).
